schema.text: Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scooter because riding is uncomfortable (weather, effort, carrying things)?

ar.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: هل تعود قلّة ركوبك الدراجة النارية أو السكوتر إلى أن ركوبها غير مريح (الطقس، التعب، حمل الأغراض)؟

de.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Fahren Sie selten Motorrad oder Roller, weil es unbequem ist (Wetter, Anstrengung, Dinge transportieren)?

en.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scooter because riding is uncomfortable (weather, effort, carrying things)?

fa.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: آیا کم موتورسواری می‌کنید چون ناراحت است (آب‌وهوا، خستگی، حمل وسایل)؟

fr.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Utilisez-vous rarement une moto ou un scooter parce que c'est inconfortable (météo, effort, objets à transporter) ?

hu.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Azért motorozik vagy robogózik ritkán, mert kényelmetlen (időjárás, fáradság, csomagok szállítása)?

it.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Usi poco la moto o lo scooter perché è scomodo (meteo, fatica, cose da portare)?

tr.#Do you rarely ride a motorcycle or scoo: Rahatsız olduğu için mi (hava, yorgunluk, eşya taşımak) nadiren motosiklet veya skuter kullanıyorsunuz?
